assumptions: For V=F_2^D, the supplied input is an acyclic concatenation grammar of linear maps C:V->V and additive independent compound-Poisson noise leaves with binary-rational mean lambda and explicit multilinear vector polynomial mark F(U) of degree <=d on uniform latent bits. Reused grammar occurrences use FRESH noise randomness. Binary repetitions compile by repeated squaring; G is compiled size and H>=1 depth. The manuscript proposes one FULL JOINT final-state sample within total variation epsilon in time polynomial in input length, D, 2^d and epsilon^-1, independent of expanded control length and numerical Poisson means apart from bit lengths. Maps need not be invertible. This is a mathematical proof candidate, not optimization of a linear program or established software/technology.
